stem.text: The graphs show trends in four physical properties of elements in Period 3, excluding argon.
Which graph has electronegativity on the $y$-axis?

A.alt: Line graph for Na to Cl: rises from Na to Mg, level to Al, peaks at Si, drops sharply at P, then falls gently to Cl.

B.alt: Line graph for Na to Cl: falls steeply from Na, then more gradually, reaching its lowest value at Cl.

C.alt: Line graph for Na to Cl: zigzag, overall rising, with dips at Al and S and the highest point at Cl.

D.alt: Line graph for Na to Cl: rises steadily and almost linearly from Na to Cl.
